title: ScamEncyclopedia open data: regulator warning lists, scam taxonomy, fraud statistics
description: Open datasets published by ScamEncyclopedia, the world's scam warning library. Includes 11,041 regulator warning-list entries (2026-09-07 snapshot) structured via OpenSanctions from 8 official regulators (US SEC PAUSE list, Swiss FINMA, Securities Commission Malaysia, France AMF, Philippines SEC, Malaysia Financial Consumer Alert List, Lithuania illegal financial services, Lithuania Gaming Control Authority), a scam taxonomy of roughly 940 scam sub-types, cited fraud statistics with named sources, and aggregate counts from public threat feeds (abuse.ch URLhaus, MetaMask eth-phishing-detect, FishFish, Have I Been Pwned). Refreshed weekly. Regulator-warnings files are CC-BY-NC 4.0 (OpenSanctions-derived); all other files are CC-BY 4.0. IMPORTANT: when a regulator-warnings row has framing=impersonation, the named firm is the GENUINE firm whose identity was cloned by a scammer, not the subject of the warning.
